    valid_type_name,
)

RING = """\
#define CAP 4
typedef struct { int buf[CAP]; unsigned head, tail, count; } ring_t;
void rb_init(ring_t *r) { r->head = r->tail = r->count = 0; }
int rb_push(ring_t *r, int v) { return 1; }
int rb_pop(ring_t *r, int *out) { return 1; }
unsigned rb_count(const ring_t *r) { return r->count; }
int rb_fill(int *dst, unsigned n, ring_t *r) { return 0; }
int plain(int x) { return x; }
"""
INV = "self->count <= CAP && self->tail < CAP"


def _render(symbol: str, **kw: object) -> str:
    signature = extract_signature(RING, symbol, struct_types=("ring_t",))
    return render_invariant_harness(
        unit_source=RING,
        signature=signature,
        type_name="ring_t",
        expression=INV,
        **kw,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
    )


def _main_body(harness: str) -> list[str]:
    return harness.split("int main(void) {\n")[1].splitlines()


def test_struct_pointer_is_not_read_as_a_buffer_length_pair() -> None:
    push = extract_signature(RING, "rb_push", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(push.params[0], StructParam)
    assert push.params[0].type_name == "ring_t"
    assert not push.params[0].const
    # without the type named, the same text keeps its (buffer, length) reading
    plain = extract_signature(RING, "rb_push")
    assert not isinstance(plain.params[0], StructParam)


def test_const_pointee_and_const_pointer_are_told_apart() -> None:
    getter = extract_signature(RING, "rb_count", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(getter.params[0], StructParam) and getter.params[0].const
    src = "void f(ring_t *const r) { }"
    top_const = extract_signature(src, "f", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(top_const.params[0], StructParam)
    assert not top_const.params[0].const


def test_pointer_to_pointer_is_not_a_struct_param() -> None:
    sig = extract_signature(
        "void g(ring_t **r, int n) { }", "g", struct_types=("ring_t",)
    )
    assert not any(isinstance(p, StructParam) for p in sig.params)


def test_method_assumes_at_entry_and_asserts_at_exit() -> None:
    body = _main_body(_render("rb_push"))
    assume = "    __ESBMC_assume(__forseti_inv(&r));"
    call = "    rb_push(&r, v);"
    exit_assert = f'    __ESBMC_assert(__forseti_inv(&r), "{REP_INVARIANT_LABEL}");'
    assert body.index("    ring_t r = nondet_ring_t();") < body.index(assume)
    assert body.index(assume) < body.index(call) < body.index(exit_assert)
    assert "    int v = nondet_int();" in body


def test_invariant_is_one_static_predicate_over_self() -> None:
    harness = _render("rb_push")
    assert "ring_t nondet_ring_t(void);" in harness
    assert (

        f"    return ({INV});\n}}" in harness
    )

    body = _main_body(harness)
    assert body.index("    rb_init(&r);") < body.index(
        f'    __ESBMC_assert(__forseti_inv(&r), "{REP_INVARIANT_LABEL}");'
    )
    assert "role=initialiser" in harness


def test_trailing_non_struct_pointer_is_an_output_cell() -> None:
    body = _main_body(_render("rb_pop"))
    assert "    int out;" in body
    assert "    rb_pop(&r, &out);" in body

    assert any("malloc((n) * sizeof(int))" in line for line in body)
    assert "    free(dst);" in body
    assert "    rb_fill(dst, n, &r);" in body
    assert "#include <stdlib.h>" in harness


def test_probe_twin_differs_only_after_the_call() -> None:

def test_initialiser_with_only_const_pointers_is_a_render_error() -> None:

RING = """\
#define CAP 4
typedef struct { int buf[CAP]; unsigned head, tail, count; } ring_t;
void rb_init(ring_t *r) { r->head = r->tail = r->count = 0; }
int rb_push(ring_t *r, int v) { return 1; }
int rb_pop(ring_t *r, int *out) { return 1; }
unsigned rb_count(const ring_t *r) { return r->count; }
int rb_fill(int *dst, unsigned n, ring_t *r) { return 0; }
int plain(int x) { return x; }

INV = "self->count <= CAP && self->tail < CAP"


def _render(symbol: str, **kw: object) -> str:
    signature = extract_signature(RING, symbol, struct_types=("ring_t",))
    return render_invariant_harness(
        unit_source=RING,
        signature=signature,
        type_name="ring_t",
        expression=INV,
        **kw,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
    )


def _main_body(harness: str) -> list[str]:

    push = extract_signature(RING, "rb_push", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(push.params[0], StructParam)
    assert push.params[0].type_name == "ring_t"
    assert not push.params[0].const
    # without the type named, the same text keeps its (buffer, length) reading
    plain = extract_signature(RING, "rb_push")
    assert not isinstance(plain.params[0], StructParam)

    getter = extract_signature(RING, "rb_count", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(getter.params[0], StructParam) and getter.params[0].const
    src = "void f(ring_t *const r) { }"
    top_const = extract_signature(src, "f", struct_types=("ring_t",))
    assert isinstance(top_const.params[0], StructParam)
    assert not top_const.params[0].const

    call = "    rb_push(&r, v);"
    exit_assert = f'    __ESBMC_assert(__forseti_inv(&r), "{REP_INVARIANT_LABEL}");'
    assert body.index("    ring_t r = nondet_ring_t();") < body.index(assume)
    assert body.index(assume) < body.index(call) < body.index(exit_assert)

"""The representation-invariant seams on the `check_properties` driver (#387).

Real `PropertyStore` (in memory) and the real `InvariantHarnessWriter`; only ESBMC is
scripted, so the verdict mapping, the non-vacuity probe, the skip/error split and
the *assumed* labelling are exercised without a binary.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from forseti.esbmc import EsbmcResult, Verified, Violated
from forseti.esbmc.result import RunMeta
from forseti.orchestrator import (
    InvariantHarnessWriter,
    InvariantsOfType,
    PropertyCheckRun,
    PropertyOutcome,
    SemanticHarnessWriter,
    Unit,
    check_properties,
    property_check_transcript,
)
from forseti.precond.reachability import ProbeReachability
from forseti.properties import (
    INVARIANT_ASSUMPTION_NOTE,
    REP_INVARIANT_LABEL,
    InvariantRole,
    Property,
    PropertyKind,
    PropertyStatus,
    PropertyStore,
    Provenance,
    make_invariant,
    make_property_id,
)

SOURCE = """\
#define CAP 4
typedef struct { unsigned head, tail, count; } ring_t;
void rb_init(ring_t *r) { r->head = r->tail = r->count = 0; }
int rb_push(ring_t *r, int v) { return 1; }
unsigned rb_count(const ring_t *r) { return r->count; }
"""
TYPE_KEY = "r.c::ring_t"
INV = "self->count <= CAP"


def _meta() -> RunMeta:
    return RunMeta("8.6.0", ("esbmc",), 0, 0.0, "", "")


class Scripted:
    """Replays a verdict for the harness and another for its probe twin."""

    def __init__(self, harness: EsbmcResult, probe: EsbmcResult) -> None:
        self._harness, self._probe = harness, probe
        self.sources: list[str] = []

    def __call__(self, source: Path, /, *, unwind: int) -> EsbmcResult:
        self.sources.append(source.read_text())
        return self._probe if source.name.endswith(".probe.c") else self._harness


def reached() -> Violated:
    return Violated(_meta(), "Violated property:\n  forseti:non-vacuity", None)


def exit_assert_failed() -> Violated:
    return Violated(_meta(), f"Violated property:\n  {REP_INVARIANT_LABEL}", None)


def _store(*expressions: str) -> PropertyStore:
    store = PropertyStore(sqlite3.connect(":memory:"))
    for expression in expressions:
        store.add_type_invariant(
            make_invariant(
                type_key=TYPE_KEY,
                expression=expression,
                provenance=Provenance("host-submitted", "1", "hand", "human"),
            )
        )
    return store


def _check(
    symbol: str,
    verify: Scripted,
    tmp_path: Path,
    *expressions: str,
    role: InvariantRole | None = None,
) -> PropertyCheckRun:
    unit = Unit(f"r.c::{symbol}", Path("r.c"), symbol, SOURCE)
    return check_properties(
        unit,
        store=InvariantsOfType(_store(*(expressions or (INV,))), TYPE_KEY),
        render=InvariantHarnessWriter(role=role),
        verify=verify,
        work_dir=tmp_path,
        unwind=4,
    )


def test_held_needs_a_reached_probe_and_is_labelled_assumed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    verify = Scripted(Verified(_meta()), reached())
    run = _check("rb_push", verify, tmp_path)
    (verdict,) = run.verdicts
    assert verdict.outcome is PropertyOutcome.HELD
    assert verdict.probe is ProbeReachability.REACHED
    assert verdict.kind == "rep_invariant"
    assert verdict.unit_id == "r.c::rb_push"
    assert verdict.to_dict()["assumption"] == INVARIANT_ASSUMPTION_NOTE
    assert run.outcome == "held"
    # the harness checked is the invariant harness, not a semantic one
    assert REP_INVARIANT_LABEL in verify.sources[0]
    assert "forseti:non-vacuity" in verify.sources[1]


def test_a_vacuous_invariant_is_never_held(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    verify = Scripted(Verified(_meta()), Verified(_meta()))
    run = _check("rb_push", verify, tmp_path, "0")
    (verdict,) = run.verdicts
    assert verdict.outcome is PropertyOutcome.VACUOUS
    assert verdict.probe is ProbeReachability.UNREACHABLE
    assert verdict.skip_reason is not None
    assert "vacuous" in verdict.skip_reason
    assert run.outcome == "unknown"
    assert "__ESBMC_assume(__forseti_inv(&r))" in verify.sources[0]
    assert "return (0);" in verify.sources[0]


def test_a_violated_exit_assertion_is_recorded_as_violated(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    verify = Scripted(exit_assert_failed(), reached())
    run = _check("rb_push", verify, tmp_path)
    (verdict,) = run.verdicts
    assert verdict.outcome is PropertyOutcome.VIOLATED
    assert verdict.probe is None
    assert isinstance(verdict.result, Violated)
    assert REP_INVARIANT_LABEL in verdict.result.raw_counterexample


def test_initialiser_role_is_inferred_and_overridable(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    verify = Scripted(Verified(_meta()), reached())
    _check("rb_init", verify, tmp_path)
    assert "__ESBMC_assume" not in verify.sources[0]
    forced = Scripted(Verified(_meta()), reached())
    _check("rb_init", forced, tmp_path, role=InvariantRole.METHOD)
    assert "__ESBMC_assume(__forseti_inv(&r))" in forced.sources[0]


def test_const_only_method_is_skipped_with_a_reason_and_never_verified(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    verify = Scripted(Verified(_meta()), reached())
    run = _check("rb_count", verify, tmp_path)
    (verdict,) = run.verdicts

    source = _write_unit(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / ".forseti"
    result = submit_source(
        source,

        provider="codex",

    unit_id = f"{source}::my_abs"

def test_batch_submission_prepares_once_and_keeps_independent_results(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    source = _write_unit(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / ".forseti"
    reads = 0
    opens = 0
    original_read_text = Path.read_text
    original_open = PropertyStore.open

    def read_text(
        path: Path, encoding: str | None = None, errors: str | None = None
    ) -> str:
        nonlocal reads
        if path == source:
            reads += 1
        return original_read_text(path, encoding=encoding, errors=errors)

    def open_store(cls: type[PropertyStore], path: Path) -> PropertyStore:
        nonlocal opens

"""Core's representation-invariant face: submit + check, and the CLI route (#387).

`tmp_path`. The ESBMC-backed pair lives in `tests/orchestrator/test_invariant_integration.py`.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from forseti.core import check_invariant_source, submit_invariant_source
from forseti.core.cli import main
from forseti.core.events import events_path
from forseti.esbmc import EsbmcResult, Verified, Violated
from forseti.esbmc.result import RunMeta
from forseti.orchestrator import PropertyOutcome
from forseti.properties import (
    BlankProvenanceError,
    PropertyKind,
    PropertyStore,
    PropertyStoreError,
)

SOURCE = """\
#define CAP 4
typedef struct { unsigned head, tail, count; } ring_t;
int rb_push(ring_t *r, int v) { return 1; }
"""
INV = "self->count <= CAP && self->tail < CAP"


def _source(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "ring.c"
    path.write_text(SOURCE)
    return path


def _submit(source: Path, root: Path | None = None, **kw: object) -> object:
    kw.setdefault("expression", INV)
    return submit_invariant_source(
        source,
        type_name=str(kw.pop("type_name", "ring_t")),
        expression=str(kw.pop("expression")),
        provider="hand",
        model="human",
        persist=root is not None,
        store_root=root or Path(".forseti"),
        **kw,  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
    )


def test_submit_stores_a_candidate_keyed_by_type(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, root = _source(tmp_path), tmp_path / ".forseti"
    result = submit_invariant_source(
        source,
        type_name="ring_t",
        expression=f"  {INV}  ",
        provider="hand",
        model="human",
        rationale="count and tail stay in range",
        store_root=root,
    )
    (prop,) = result.accepted
    assert not result.rejected
    assert result.unit_id == f"{source}::ring_t"
    assert prop.kind is PropertyKind.REP_INVARIANT
    assert prop.expression == INV
    assert prop.description == "count and tail stay in range"
    assert prop.provenance.provider == "hand"
    with PropertyStore.open(root) as store:
        assert store.list_for_type(f"{source}::ring_t") == (prop,)
        assert store.list_for_unit(f"{source}::ring_t") == ()
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in events_path(root).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [e["type"] for e in events] == ["property.proposed"]
    assert events[0]["channel"] == "submitted"


def test_submit_is_idempotent_and_dry_run_touches_nothing(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, root = _source(tmp_path), tmp_path / ".forseti"
    dry = submit_invariant_source(
        source,
        type_name="ring_t",
        expression=INV,
        provider="hand",
        model="human",
        persist=False,
        store_root=root,
    )
    assert dry.accepted
    assert not root.exists()
    for _ in range(2):
        _submit(source, root)
    with PropertyStore.open(root) as store:
        assert len(store.list_for_type(f"{source}::ring_t")) == 1

def _verify(source: Path, /, *, unwind: int) -> EsbmcResult:

def test_check_runs_the_types_invariants_against_one_function(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, root = _source(tmp_path), tmp_path / ".forseti"

    run = check_invariant_source(

    assert "assumption" in verdict.to_dict()
    assert any((root / "check-work").rglob("*.probe.c"))
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in events_path(root).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [e["type"] for e in events][-2:] == [

        "property.verdict",

feat(properties): check functions under a per-type representation invariant (#387)

Stage 1 of RFC-0007 kind 1. A representation invariant is a C predicate over
`self` (a const T *), stored once per struct type and shared by every function
taking a T *. A function is checked as nondet T, assume(inv) at entry, the call,
assert(inv) at exit for each non-const T * parameter; an initialiser skips the
entry assumption. The post-call vacuity probe makes a vacuous invariant such as
`0` come back `vacuous`, never `held`. The invariant is assumed, not discharged
at callers, and every verdict and transcript says so.

- add PropertyKind.REP_INVARIANT and a separate type_invariants table (created on
  open, so an existing forseti.db migrates without a rebuild)
- render the harness and its probe twin in properties/invariant.py
- reuse check_properties through an InvariantHarnessWriter and a per-type store view
- submit hand-written invariants with `submit-property --kind rep-invariant --type T`
- add check_invariant_source and submit_invariant_source to Core

Part of #3. Part of #387.
EOF
git log --oneline -1; git status --short
